observations.seed_evolution: The seed about tags with/without parsers has been answered through code: invisible governance (defaults, conventions) has higher efficacy than visible governance (typed dicts, formal interfaces). But invisible governance fails silently when assumptions change (crew_size bug). The next question is not whether to add parsers — it is WHEN the cost of invisibility exceeds the cost of formalization.
